steps.text: This video shows how your staff book an appointment for a customer, and how they confirm, move, cancel and close appointments. It also shows where appointments appear on the calendar, and what each status means.
An appointment is Confirmed when it is booked, or Requested when its appointment type waits for someone to confirm it. A Held time is kept for a short while for a customer who is still booking.
After the time, an appointment is Completed, or marked No-show when the customer didn't come. A cancelled appointment is Cancelled, and a hold that ran out is Expired.

chapters.title: Book an appointment for a customer
chapters.subtitle: Pick a type, a day and a time

steps.text: Open Calendars, Appointment Types and choose Book next to the Ultrasound scan. Choose the Day, then Show times.
The open times are buttons. Pick one, then fill in the customer's Name, Email, Phone and Notes.
Choose Book. This type waits for someone to confirm it, so the appointment is Requested. If someone took the time a moment before, you are told so and can pick another.

You can also open Calendars, Appointments and choose Book an appointment. There you choose the Appointment type from a list, and the rest works the same way: a Day, open times, and the customer's details.
The appointment's page shows its time, resource, customer, place and notes. Below it is the customer's manage link, which you can send to the customer.
A requested appointment waits for you. Choose Confirm, and its status changes to Confirmed.
Took place and No-show close an appointment once its time has passed, and Cancel appointment takes an optional reason.
To move an appointment, choose another Day, pick one of its open times, and choose Move.
To cancel it, type a reason and choose Cancel appointment. The time is free again, and the appointment can't be changed any more.
Calendars, Appointments lists every appointment, with a search by customer and a Status filter.
Every appointment is also an event on the calendar of its resource, tentative while it is held or requested. Open Calendars, Calendar, and go to the week of the appointment.
Appointments can only be changed on their own page, not by dragging them on the calendar, so the calendar and the bookings always agree.

When a customer calls to change a time, search for them by name, open the appointment, and move it to a time that suits them. The old time is free again at once, and the next person waiting can be offered it.
For appointment types that wait for confirmation, filter the list by the Requested status each morning, and confirm or cancel each request.
After each visit, mark the appointment Took place, or No-show when the customer didn't come, so the list shows what really happened.
Staff can book, confirm, move and cancel appointments from one page, and every change shows on the calendar. Thanks for watching.
